name: StoneYield USD
oneLiner: stUSD is StoneYield's BNB Chain yield wrapper over USDC routed through a Venus-linked strategy layer; tracked as a managed wrapper, not a plain fiat stablecoin.
collateral: USDC and yield-bearing USDC positions routed through StoneYield's protocol contracts and Venus-linked strategy layer
pegMechanism: StoneYield wrapper token designed to maintain one-dollar accounting against deposited stablecoin assets while strategy yield accrues through the protocol's managed vault structure

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: StoneYield USD is a managed yield wrapper on BNB Chain; docs identify protocol controls, but available sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist function.

reserves.name: USDC and yield-bearing USDC strategy positions

mintAuthority.summary: stUSD is StoneYield's strategy-vault token over USDC-routed strategies, but StoneYield docs expose local mint and emergency controls including deposit minting, rewardMint(), pause(), adminUnlock(), and sweepUSDC(); its mint authority is not inherited-only from USDC.

controls.label: StoneYield stUSD deposit mint path
controls.capDescription: User deposits USDC into StakeableAssetImpl/StrategyRouter, which mints stUSD shares against strategy assets; the token does not create base USDC supply but can mint local stUSD shares.
controls.evidence: StoneYield contract-design docs describe the flow `User Deposits USDC -> StakeableAssetImpl (mints STUSD) -> StrategyRouter`.

controls.label: StoneYield stUSD reward/emergency admin controls
controls.evidence: StoneYield docs list admin rewardMint(), pause(), adminUnlock(), and sweepUSDC() controls on the STUSD token design; exact owner/admin holder was not resolved in this pass.

review.evidence: StoneYield docs describe stUSD share minting from USDC deposits plus admin rewardMint and emergency controls, so the local token has its own permissioned mint/admin surface even though base USDC supply remains Circle-issued.
review.sourceFreeRationale: StoneYield docs document local STUSD mint/admin functions; exact owner/admin holder was not resolved from the BSC contract in this pass.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the live BSC owner/admin holder for rewardMint(), pause(), adminUnlock(), and sweepUSDC().

notices.title: Yield wrapper, not a plain cash stablecoin
notices.message: stUSD is tracked because CoinGecko returns a live price and market cap, but its structure is a managed yield wrapper around stablecoin strategies rather than a simple fiat-backed dollar token.
